results.pair_summary: Both documents define the Chron-LLM Delta3 bootloader sequence in Lisp. Document B (Phase 1.1) is a refined evolution of Document A, introducing explicit logging, fail-fast error handling, granular layer decomposition (Core/Graph/World), and strict architectural constraints (No ASDF/Lazy Load).
results.integration_rationale: Document B supersedes A by enforcing critical Delta3 Kernel stability requirements (FailFast invariant, explicit dependency ordering) absent in A's lenient 'warn' logic. Merging B into the canonical llama-agent.spec ensures the bootloader adheres to Phase 1.1 constraints and prevents silent failures during system initialization.
